T: Istanbul for lunch. The night train for dinner.
D: Bond travels to Istanbul to help a Soviet clerk defect with a top secret coding machine.
P: Serve the snacks when Bond lands in Istanbul and Kerim Bey's driver picks him up.
S: Istanbul's street bread, bought on the way to the bazaar

Knead 350g plain flour, 7g dry yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt, 220ml warm water and 2 tbsp olive oil for 10 minutes and rise for an hour. Divide into 8, roll each into two thin ropes, twist together and join into rings. Dip in 80ml grape molasses mixed with 80ml water, then in 120g sesame seeds. Rest 15 minutes and bake at 220C for 15 minutes until deep golden. Serve warm with feta.
shells packed with spiced rice, pine nuts, currants, dill and mint, Galata waterfront style

Soak 150g rice for 20 minutes. Fry an onion and 2 tbsp pine nuts in 3 tbsp oil, add the rice, allspice, cinnamon, tomato paste, sugar, salt, pepper, currants and 250ml water and simmer covered for 10 minutes, then stir in dill and mint and cool. Prise open 24 cleaned mussels at the flat edge without separating the shells, fill each with rice and close. Pack into a pot with 200ml water, weigh down with a plate and steam for 20 minutes. Serve at room temperature with lemon.
M: the dinner where Bond should have watched the wine order

Boil 600g new potatoes until tender and blanch 250g green beans. Season 600g sole fillets, dust with flour and fry in 2 tbsp oil and 20g butter for 2 minutes a side. Brown 80g butter until nutty, add the juice of a lemon, a tbsp of capers and parsley and spoon over the fish. Serve with the potatoes, beans and lemon wedges.
Kerim Bey's camp supper lamb shish
chargrilled skewers of spiced meat, capsicum and onion, bulgur and yoghurt, before the camp shootout

Chargrilled lamb, capsicum and onion skewers with bulgur pilaf, yoghurt and a shepherd's salad. Toss the lamb with the paprika, cumin, 2 tbsp of the oil, half the lemon juice and salt. Thread onto skewers with chunks of capsicum and onion. Fry the bulgur in the butter for 1 minute, add 500ml water and salt, cover and simmer for 15 minutes, then rest for 5. Dice the tomatoes and cucumber and mix with chopped parsley, the rest of the oil and lemon. Grill the skewers on a very hot grill for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until charred. Serve on the pilaf with yoghurt and the salad.
W: bought by the box in the bazaar while somebody watches Bond

Boil 600g sugar, 200ml water and 1 tbsp lemon juice to 115C. Cook 100g cornflour, 1 tsp cream of tartar and 600ml water to a thick paste, slowly whisk in the syrup and simmer very gently for an hour, stirring often, until pale gold and very thick. Stir in 1.5 tbsp rosewater, a few drops of pink colouring and 50g pistachios, pour into an oiled, lined 20cm tin and set overnight. Cut into cubes and toss in icing sugar and cornflour.

K: the station chief pours for his friends, cloudy and red

Fill 4 glasses with ice. Add 30ml raki, a little lemon juice and sugar syrup to each and stir until cloudy. Top with 200ml pomegranate juice and 200ml soda between them and finish with mint and pomegranate seeds.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 1 day ahead and warm at 180C for 5 minutes; the dough can also rise slowly in the fridge overnight

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, salt, warm water and oil and knead for 10 minutes until smooth.
Cover and leave to rise for an hour until doubled.
Heat the oven to 220C. Divide into 8, roll each into two thin ropes, twist them together and join the ends into a ring.
Dip each ring in the molasses mixed with the water, then press into the sesame seeds on both sides.
Rest on lined trays for 15 minutes.
Bake for 15 minutes until deep golden.
Cool slightly and serve with the feta.

dishes.make_ahead: Cook the spiced rice up to 1 day ahead; stuff and steam the mussels on the day, they are best at room temperature

steps.text: Soak the rice in hot water for 20 minutes, then drain.
Scrub and debeard the mussels, throwing out any that stay open when tapped.

Fry the onion and pine nuts in the oil for 8 minutes until golden. Add the rice, allspice, cinnamon, tomato paste, sugar, salt, pepper, currants and 250ml of the water, cover and simmer for 10 minutes until the water is absorbed but the rice is still firm. Stir in the dill and mint.
Spread the rice on a tray to cool.
Slide a small knife into each mussel at the flat edge and open it without separating the shells. Fill with a spoonful of rice and close.
Pack the mussels into a pot, pour in the rest of the water, weigh down with a plate, cover and steam for 20 minutes.
Cool for 10 minutes and serve with the lemon wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Roll the vine leaves up to 2 days ahead, simmer and keep chilled; serve at room temperature

steps.text: Soak the rice in hot water for 20 minutes, then drain.
Rinse the vine leaves in hot water and snip off any stems.

Fry the onion and pine nuts in the oil for 8 minutes until golden. Add the rice, allspice, cinnamon, tomato paste, sugar, salt, pepper, currants and 250ml of the water, cover and simmer for 10 minutes until the water is absorbed but the rice is still firm. Stir in the dill and mint.
Spread the rice on a tray to cool.
Lay each leaf vein side up, put a spoonful of rice near the stem end, fold in the sides and roll up tight.
Pack seam side down into a pot, pour in the rest of the water and the juice of 1 lemon, weigh down with a plate, cover and simmer for 40 minutes.
Cool for 15 minutes and serve with the other lemon in wedges.

dishes.make_ahead: Best cooked just before serving; boil the potatoes and trim the beans up to a few hours ahead

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and keep warm.
Blanch the beans in boiling water for 3 minutes and drain.
Season the fish with salt and pepper and dust lightly with the flour.
Fry the fillets in the oil and 20g of the butter for 2 minutes a side, in batches. Keep warm on plates.
Wipe the pan, add the rest of the butter and cook until it smells nutty and turns light brown. Add the juice of 1 lemon, the capers and parsley.
Spoon the butter over the plates and serve with the potatoes, beans and the other lemon in wedges.

veg.n: Orient Express dining car haloumi meunière
veg.make_ahead: Best cooked just before serving; boil the potatoes and trim the beans up to a few hours ahead

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and keep warm.
Blanch the beans in boiling water for 3 minutes and drain.
Pat the haloumi dry, season with pepper and dust lightly with the flour.
Fry the haloumi in the oil and 20g of the butter for 2 minutes a side until golden. Keep warm on plates.
Wipe the pan, add the rest of the butter and cook until it smells nutty and turns light brown. Add the juice of 1 lemon, the capers and parsley.
Spoon the butter over the plates and serve with the potatoes, beans and the other lemon in wedges.

Fry the bulgur in the butter for 1 minute, add 500ml water and salt, cover and simmer for 15 minutes, then rest for 5.
Dice the tomatoes and cucumber and mix with chopped parsley, the rest of the oil and lemon.
Grill the skewers on a very hot grill for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until charred.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate the halloumi up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Toss chunks of halloumi with the paprika, cumin, 2 tbsp of the oil and half the lemon juice. Thread onto skewers with chunks of capsicum and onion.
Fry the bulgur in the butter for 1 minute, add 500ml water and salt, cover and simmer for 15 minutes, then rest for 5.
Dice the tomatoes and cucumber and mix with chopped parsley, the rest of the oil and lemon.
Grill the skewers on a very hot grill for 6 minutes, turning, until charred.
Serve on the pilaf with yoghurt and the salad.

dishes.make_ahead: Cook and leave to set overnight at room temperature, at least 12 hours; keeps 2 weeks airtight in its dusting sugar

ingredients.item: pink food colouring, a few drops

steps.text: Oil a 20cm square tin and line it with baking paper.
Boil the sugar, 200ml of the water and the lemon juice to 115C on a sugar thermometer.
In a second heavy pan whisk the cornflour for the jelly and the cream of tartar into the remaining 600ml water and cook, stirring, until it becomes a thick paste.
Slowly whisk the hot syrup into the paste. Simmer very gently for an hour, stirring often, until pale gold and very thick.
Stir in the rosewater, colouring and pistachios and pour into the tin.
Leave uncovered at room temperature to set overnight.
Mix the icing sugar and cornflour for dusting. Cut into cubes with an oiled knife and toss in the mix.

dishes.make_ahead: Chill the juice and soda and pick the pomegranate seeds up to 1 day ahead; build in the glass to order

steps.text: Fill 4 glasses with ice.
Add the raki, lemon juice and sugar syrup and stir until it turns cloudy.
Top with the pomegranate juice and soda.
Finish with a mint sprig and a few pomegranate seeds.

af.make_ahead: Steep and chill the anise tea up to 2 days ahead; build in the glass to order

steps.text: Steep the star anise and fennel seeds in the boiling water for 10 minutes, strain and chill for 20 minutes.
Fill 4 glasses with ice.
Add the anise tea, lemon juice and sugar syrup and stir.
Top with the pomegranate juice and soda.
Finish with a mint sprig and a few pomegranate seeds.
